name: Doolittle Trailer Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Doolittle Trailer Mfg., Inc. stands as a premier manufacturer of utility, equipment, enclosed, and dump trailers, proudly headquartered in Holts Summit, Missouri, near Kansas City. With a legacy spanning over thirty years, we have continuously supplied dealers with top-quality trailers at competitive prices. Our commitment to excellence in manufacturing has solidified our position as a leading provider in the industry. From utility trailers to enclosed options and dump trailers, our diverse product range caters to a wide array of hauling needs. Located in the heart of Missouri, our strategic location near Kansas City allows us to serve our customers efficiently and effectively. As we celebrate over three decades of service, we remain dedicated to providing superior trailers that deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and value to our customers and dealers alike.
about:
Doolittle Trailer Manufacturing Inc. is based in Holts Summit, Missouri, near Kansas City. Founded in 1978, the company has operated for over four decades as a manufacturer of utility, equipment, enclosed, dump, and deckover trailers. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces a range of trailers including utility, equipment, enclosed, dump, and deckover models. Its manufacturing process includes a two-part epoxy primer and two-part polyurethane paint finish, which the company says outperforms traditional powder coating. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Doolittle sells primarily through a dealer network, serving customers in construction, landscaping, and recreational hauling. End users include contractors moving heavy equipment, landscapers transporting materials, and outdoor enthusiasts hauling recreational gear.

The company emphasizes a "We Make It Easy" philosophy, focusing on simplifying the purchasing process from selection to delivery. It cites premium materials, innovative design, and skilled craftsmanship as differentiators, along with a paint system designed for durability against corrosion and abrasion.
